articles.title: Hundreds of flights cancelled across East Asia as Typhoon Champi roars toward Taiwan - BBC
articles.description: At least one person has died in Taiwan as Japan, China and South Korea also brace for the powerful storm.
articles.content:
Taiwanese authorities issued urgent safety warnings on Thursday ahead of Typhoon Champi's landfall.
